title: Make room for another person
description: Jesus Christ listens attentively to an older man, honoring him with unhurried presence. The compassion Christ shows in Third Nephi makes room for people's needs before He departs.
alt: Jesus Christ listening attentively to an elderly man in a courtyard

title: Learn from Christ, then practice His teaching
description: Jesus Christ teaches two attentive disciples. His commandment to love one another places recognizable Christian discipleship in the patience, honesty and charity shown across differences in belief.

title: Let a conversation lead to care
description: Two women prepare a meal together, turning conversation into a practical act of care while leaving room for different beliefs.
alt: Two women preparing a vegetable meal and covering a dish in a home kitchen

title: Come forward and know
description: The risen Jesus Christ extends His invitation to people gathered at Bountiful. Each person is welcomed to come forward and know for themselves that He is the God of Israel.

title: Give a passage your attention
description: A woman pauses beside a quiet lake with an open book in her lap. The still water and unhurried posture echo Moroni's invitation to remember, ponder and ask God with faith in Christ.
alt: A woman with an open book on her lap pausing to look across a quiet lake

title: Compare the accounts with care
description: Two open books rest side by side, representing distinct scriptural witnesses. John and Third Nephi each bear witness of the risen Jesus Christ so people can know Him and believe.

title: Listen to what another reader notices
description: An older woman and a younger man compare open books on a park bench. Their exchange reflects how two scriptural witnesses can deepen a conversation centered on Jesus Christ.
alt: An older woman and an adult man discussing their open scripture books on a park bench

title: Prepare through learning
description: Open scriptures rest beside a notebook and folded jacket, suggesting deliberate preparation for worship. The Kirtland dedicatory prayer joins learning, faith and order in a house devoted to God.
alt: Hands holding an open scripture book beside a closed notebook and folded jacket

title: Connect worship with daily commitments
description: A father and adult daughter talk while sharing the work of washing and drying dishes, connecting promises to God with patient care in daily life.
alt: A father and adult daughter talking while washing and drying dishes

title: Joseph Smith's accounts across time
description: A nineteenth-century desk, handwritten record and inkwell recall the work of preserving Joseph Smith's accounts. Their dates, authorship and distinct details help illuminate how he described his search for God over time.

title: Make room for prayer
description: Jesus withdraws into a quiet wilderness to pray. His solitude and stillness reflect a life repeatedly renewed through communion with the Father.

title: Study, ask and keep a careful record
description: A man writes beside an open book, placing prayer, thoughtful effort and a responsible next step together. The Lord's counsel to Oliver Cowdery joins seeking God's help with patient study.
alt: A man keeping a notebook beside an open book during a quiet pause

title: Let care extend beyond your household
description: A parent and teenager clear an older neighbor's path together. Their care extends family discipleship outward through service that respects what the neighbor needs.
alt: A parent and teenager helping an older neighbor clear a path

title: Make space for each person’s voice
description: A multigenerational family listens as a teenager speaks from a shared reading. Their attention reflects a home where different ages, questions and experiences can remain joined by kindness in Christ.

title: Morning at the empty tomb
description: Morning light enters an open garden tomb, holding the astonishment and hope of the Resurrection. Mary's grief gives way when the risen Jesus calls her by name.

title: Hold hope and remembrance together
description: A grandmother shares a keepsake and memory with her grandson. Remembering someone who has died can hold present sorrow beside hope in Christ's Resurrection.
alt: A grandmother sharing a keepsake and a memory with her grandson

title: Bring the whole storm account into view
description: Jesus remains with frightened disciples as wind and waves surround their boat. Mark's account bears witness to His power and presence without placing a timetable on relief in another person's trial.

title: Take the next step with support
description: A woman with a walking stick moves along a woodland path beside a companion. Their measured pace reflects faithful progress supported by another person while difficulty continues.
alt: A woman using a walking stick beside a companion on a woodland path

title: Listen without setting a timetable
description: One woman speaks while another listens without hurry. Such presence honors the covenant to mourn with those who mourn and lets compassionate care be guided by the person who grieves.

title: Leave room for a steady next step
description: A woman reads quietly on a window seat while her surroundings are still unsettled. A brief return to Christ's words can offer steadiness alongside the practical work of rebuilding life.
alt: A woman reading quietly on a window seat during a period of change

title: Consider a covenant in practice
description: A family brings groceries and a covered meal to an older neighbor. Their service gives living form to the baptismal covenant to bear burdens, mourn together and offer comfort.
